Theorem
[Trace Harnack estimate for Ricci flow] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0394, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0395 ↗ cor:chow-ii-trace-harnack-and-tr-monotonicity 1. appD:D.26\group Harnack Estimates

For a compact, or complete bounded-curvature, Ricci flow with nonnegative curvature operator, every vector field $V$ satisfies \[ \partial _tR+\frac Rt+2\langle \nabla R,V\rangle +2\operatorname {Ric}(V,V)\geq 0. \] In particular $\partial _t(tR)\geq 0$ and $R(x,t_2)\geq (t_1/t_2)R(x,t_1)$ when $0<t_1\leq t_2$.
